title: Checking a shelf estimate
passage:
Was that estimate for replacing both shelves?
A. I just need to find a taller ladder.
B. Only the lower one was included in that figure.
C. We can reach the upper shelf without moving the desk.
passageZh:
那份估價包含更換兩層架板嗎？
A. 我只需要再找一把高一點的梯子。
B. 那個金額只算了下面那層。
C. 不用挪桌子就能碰到上層。
